P-GEN-1 — CARD V6, ALL PINS FROZEN, ON THE ADMITTED TWELVE
Prior 45%. Family m = 6. Filed before the look; never amended.

1 · THE CLAIM

Does card v6, with every pin frozen exactly as the TIER-C series left it, show per-campaign
expectancy in R above zero on twelve assets no scored book of this estate has ever ridden?

This is a claim about GENERALISATION BY ASSET and about nothing else. No knob moves, no pin is
refitted, no grid is searched. The single thing that differs from the lineage's control is WHICH
assets the card rides. No direction, magnitude, campaign count or verdict is promised here.

THE PANEL'S NICKNAME IS "THE UNSEEN TWELVE" AND THE NICKNAME IS WRONG. Only THREE of the twelve
are never-touched. Nine were looked at by this estate. §7(a) carries the measurement; it governs,
and the nickname does not. Nothing in this text may be read as a claim that the twelve are virgin.

3 · THE PANEL — AND BOTH ADMITTED LISTS, NAMED

  UNIUSDT · 1000PEPEUSDT · DOGEUSDT · 1000BONKUSDT          (N = 12, panel_name UNSEEN12)

THE OTHER ADMITTED LIST. The admission rule read from STAGE_D_MANIFEST admission.rule is

4 · THE BOOK, THE RULER, THE BASE, THE ERA, THE LINE

RUNNER run_cell_n. CARD = tierc8.Card with every field at its default — which IS card v6 — and
ROLES = tierc9.V6_ROLES (tide_f 89, tide_s 316, win_f 12, win_s 89, trg_f 12, trg_s 26). "ALL pins
frozen" is not a promise in prose here; it is an equality the gate checks:
ride_spec(card, roles) must equal tierc10_panel.CONTROL_RIDE field for field — card_class
"tierc8.Card", roles_class "tierc9.Roles", and the card's TWENTY-NINE fields at
grid 'card', entry_rail_atr 1.0, lane 'card', limit_ae_mult None, trail True, trail_l 2, trail_r 2,
trail_extra_buf_atr 0.0, trail_arm_after_r 1.0, harvest 'band', harvest_fixed_r 2.0,
harvest_min_unit_r -inf, time_stop_bars None, funding_ceiling_r 1.0, adds_max 0, add_size 1.0,
seal_open True, trail_min_advance_atr 0.05, harvest_frac 0.5, wall_exit_atr None, wall_tf '12h',
hybrid_anchor False, weave False, reentry False, ae_abort_r None, weave_k 6,
stop_grid_offset_atr 0.0, anchor_kind 'pivot', anchor_offset 0.5. That is twenty-nine names and
twenty-nine values; tierc8.Card has thirty fields and ride_spec drops only the free `name`. If one
field differs, the book is refused at the gate and no row exists.
LANES ("card",).
RULER vs_zero, BASE zero: a one-sample asset-cluster bootstrap of the mean net_r, 4000 draws, 90%
percentile interval, clusters = assets.
WINDOW: corridor_n over the twelve — one unbroken window with PER-ASSET floors, each asset first
arming at its own bar 316 — ending at the as-of, never later than Stage D's write-once pin. First
scorable bars, read from panel_funding first_scorable_bar and equal to each asset's floor_4h in
panel_corridor: LTCUSDT 2020-03-02T00:00:00Z · XMRUSDT 2020-03-27T00:00:00Z ·
BNBUSDT 2020-04-03T00:00:00Z · DOGEUSDT 2020-09-01T00:00:00Z · UNIUSDT 2020-11-09T20:00:00Z ·
SUIUSDT 2023-06-25T08:00:00Z · 1000PEPEUSDT 2023-06-27T08:00:00Z ·
MNTUSDT_BYBIT 2023-11-23T20:00:00Z · 1000BONKUSDT 2024-01-14T04:00:00Z ·
ENAUSDT 2024-05-25T04:00:00Z · HYPEUSDT 2025-07-22T00:00:00Z · PUMPUSDT 2025-08-31T20:00:00Z.

ERA "full", on every arm. The era is named because every arm must name one and an era chosen after
the look is a choice of the friendlier sample; the cut is 2024-06-30T23:59:59Z = 1719791999000 ms
and it does not cut this window. WHY "full" is the honest era here: the collar
[R1 → executor lean] exists to stop a pin being judged on the bars that tuned it. No pin of card v6
was fitted on any of the twelve — the TC-series fitted on BTCUSDT ETHUSDT SOLUSDT NEARUSDT ZECUSDT,
the estate's scored universe. The out-of-sample dimension this registration claims is the ASSET,
not the calendar. Whoever reads the row should hold it to that and to nothing more. (Attribution,
exactly: OPERATOR_RULINGS.md records R1 as the EMA-band question; the era collar is the executor
lean filed under it, and that file states the lean is marked as such and is NOT the ruling.)

LOAO LINE OF RECORD: lineage count. N is the DECLARED panel, the law of tierc7.loao, the only
count with a nine-tier history. Under it a declared asset that yields no campaign leaves the book
unchanged when it is dropped, and its leave-out panel is still counted; a leave-out panel that
cannot be bootstrapped counts AGAINST the line. The excl-zero-campaign count is printed beside it
on every row (loao_n already emits loao_above_excl_zero_campaign_panels and
loao_clears_excl_zero_campaign_panels, so this promise is code, not prose). The chosen count is NOT
the stricter of the two: exactly where a young asset yields no campaign, it is the more permissive
one, and that hazard is live on this panel — PUMPUSDT's first scorable bar is
2025-08-31T20:00:00Z and HYPEUSDT's is 2025-07-22T00:00:00Z. So this registration commits, before
the look, to this: if the two counts DISAGREE, the row says so, and a clear that depends on
zero-campaign panels is read and reported as weak evidence, never as support.

THE ABOVE-HALF BAR is above_half_bar(N) = ceil((N+1)/2), strict majority: 2/3 · 3/5 · 7/12 · 9/17.
The contract's "LOAO above-half 3/5" is the N=5 case of that same law and not a different rule
[LEAN L6]; it has not been overridden, loosened or re-chosen. On this registration's scored arm
N = 12 and the bar is 7 of 12; on the seventeen-asset arm, 9 of 17; on the never-touched arm, 2 of
3. Panels whose interval lies wholly BELOW zero are counted and printed separately and never count
toward robustness: a panel that reliably shows the arm is worse is not evidence that it is better.

NO STANDING RULING MOVES THIS REGISTRATION. REGISTRATION_PLAN.md "Rulings in force" carries R8 (the
BRK panel is CLASSIC5), R9 (P-SPR-2 rides the full corridor, standalone vs zero) and R10 (the null
of record is gaps+order). R8 governs a different panel, R9 a different registration, and P-GEN-1
runs no null, so R10 is idle here. P-GEN-1's panel is set by STAGE_D_MANIFEST
panels.UNSEEN_admitted_stems and contract lines 50 and 90, by nothing else. This sentence exists so
a reader does not have to derive that absence.

5 · THE ARMS

ARM 1 — "unseen12-card-v6" — SCORED, and the only arm of this registration with a slot in m.
  panel UNSEEN12 (the twelve of §3) · lanes ("card",) · ruler vs_zero · base zero ·
  runner run_cell_n (card v6, V6_ROLES) · era full · LOAO bar 7/12.
ARM 2 — "panel17-card-v6" — REPORT-ONLY (Tier-E), no slot in m.
  panel PANEL17 = BTCUSDT ETHUSDT SOLUSDT NEARUSDT ZECUSDT ENAUSDT PUMPUSDT HYPEUSDT
  MNTUSDT_BYBIT SUIUSDT LTCUSDT XMRUSDT BNBUSDT UNIUSDT 1000PEPEUSDT DOGEUSDT 1000BONKUSDT ·
  same card, roles, lanes, ruler, base, era · LOAO bar 9/17.
  THIS ARM IS NOT A GENERALISATION TEST AND MAY NOT BE READ AS ONE: five of its seventeen assets
  are the assets card v6 was built on. It exists because the admitted list on disk is seventeen
  and the contract asks for the seventeen-asset view beside the row.
ARM 3 — "never-touched-card-v6" — REPORT-ONLY (Tier-E), no slot in m.
  panel PUMPUSDT · MNTUSDT_BYBIT · SUIUSDT (N = 3, panel_name CUSTOM3:6bf107e8) ·
  same card, roles, lanes, ruler, base, era · LOAO bar 2/3.
  This is the contract's "LOAO printed twice (all admitted · never-touched only)", and its panel is
  exactly DATA_SPEND_AUDIT.json never_touched = [PUMPFUN, MNT, SUI] in cache stems. Because
  run_cell_n replays each symbol independently and each asset arms at its OWN bar 316, arm 3's
  campaigns must be exactly the three-symbol subset of arm 1's book. That is an assertion, not an
  assumption: if the two books disagree on any campaign of those three symbols, the disagreement is
  printed and the arm is reported as broken rather than quietly kept.

All three arms are built by CALLING arm_spec(...) — never hand-written — so `panel_name` and the
`ride` dict are the function's output and survive _check_spec's re-validation. Prose about an arm
lives in register(fields={...}), which is hashed beside the text and gates nothing.

6 · WHAT WOULD COUNT AS SUPPORT — AND WHAT WOULD NOT

The verdict column is the lineage's law and reads nothing but the interval: SUPPORTED iff the LOWER
bound of the 90% percentile cluster-bootstrap CI on the RAW panel expectancy is STRICTLY greater
than zero. A bound of exactly 0.0, a missing bound, an interval straddling zero and an interval
wholly below zero are all NOT SUPPORTED. The raw panel expectancy carries the verdict — it is the
lineage's ruler since TIER-C5 and the only statistic here with a history; the equal-asset-risk
co-headline carries its own cluster-bootstrap CI, which is NEW in TIER-C10, rides beside the row
and gates nothing. Where the two disagree, the row says so.

THIS REGISTRATION WILL READ AS SUPPORT FOR THE CLAIM IN §1 ONLY THE CONJUNCTION OF THREE:
  (a) verdict SUPPORTED — CI lower bound > 0 on the raw panel expectancy of ARM 1;
  (b) clears_bh_bar — p_one_sided <= q/m = 0.10/6 = 0.016667, ONE fixed bar per scored row, no
      step-up, m = 6 declared before the look, so the six are independently failable [L7];
  (c) the LOAO line of record at or above 7 of 12.
Any two of the three without the third is NOT support for the general claim and will be reported as
what it is. In particular, a CI clear whose LOAO line falls below 7/12 is evidence about a handful
of assets, not about the card, and this text forbids its being written up as the latter. A result
that is negative, flat, or thin is a result: it is reported at the same size as any other.

7 · THE EVIDENCE ALREADY ON FILE THAT WEIGHS AGAINST THIS CLAIM

A registration that hides a known headwind is worthless as a pre-commitment. Four bear on the
claim directly; §2 and §8 carry two more, and nothing is held back.

(a) "TWELVE UNSEEN ASSETS" IS THIS BUILD'S NICKNAME, NOT ITS MEASURED STATE. THE TWELVE ARE NOT
VIRGIN, AND THIS TEXT DOES NOT CLAIM THEY ARE.
F-D-5's data-spend audit (research_outputs/tierc10/data/DATA_SPEND_AUDIT.json, sha256
24cd11f1a882de527128c73c76fa7aaa61bd755599829aa9df1001157fa8fd89) grepped 65 files / 42,651 lines
and filed 981 evidence lines. Its counts are display-only 9, never-touched 3, scored 5, and its
never_touched list is exactly PUMPFUN, MNT, SUI — THREE of the twelve, not twelve. The other NINE
— ENA HYPE LTC XMR BNB UNI PEPE DOGE BONK — are classed display-only, defined there as "it
appeared in a chart / brief / census print but never in a scored book": all nine sit in the
Oracle's 18-symbol display roster (scripts/oracle_daily.py REGISTER['ROSTER']['value']), and HYPE
also in the frozen study basket (engine/cells.py SYMBOLS, tier C). HYPE is the loudest of them: 65
corpus hits, 53 of them in the root_book class (the estate's result books, builder contracts and
change logs together). HYPE was READ, not assumed. The audit's own evidence line quotes
LEDGER.md:217, whose clause (g) reads whole "(g) RC-0: all 10 assets (7 scored + HYPE, FARTCOIN,
LIT) carry {1m,5m,15m,1h,4h,12h};" — the estate's own words placing HYPE outside that basket's
SCORED set. The remainder of that line is not quoted here: it says which timeframes are absent for
every asset and which are locally resamplable, and it bears on nothing in this registration. The
audit warns in turn, in corpus_class_note, that "A HIT THERE IS NOT PROOF OF SCORING (HYPE is
named 53 times there and is display-only)". Both halves are reported here: the 53 mentions are not
evidence that HYPE was scored, and they are evidence that HYPE was looked at. For the three
never-touched, counted as the audit counts them — one row per ASSET over that asset's whole token
set, which is wider than the cache stem (PUMPFUN's tokens are PUMPFUNUSDT, PUMPUSDT, PUMPFUN,
PUMP; MNT's are MNTUSDT_BYBIT, MNTUSDT, MNT) — the PUMPFUN row carries 9 corpus hits and the MNT
row 7, none of them in the root_book class, and the SUI row 0 anywhere.
WHAT THIS MEANS FOR HOW THE ROW READS. A display-only asset is not a virgin one. Nine of the twelve
have been LOOKED AT by this estate — charted, rostered, printed — even though no scored book ever
rode them, and the audit measures files, not eyes: it cannot exclude that a human who designed or
kept card v6 had those charts in view. So ARM 1 is an out-of-sample test BY THE STRONGEST MEASURE
THIS BUILD MADE, and it is NOT a virgin-sample test. The measure has named limits and they are part
of the disclosure: DATA_SPEND_AUDIT corpus_excluded = ['_reviewer_box', 'docs/history',
'research_outputs/tierc10', 'research_outputs/tierc10_run2', '.git'] — the first two for the grep
hazard, this build's own output to keep the audit from being self-referential — and every kept line
is cut at 240 chars. A stronger audit is possible; this is the one that exists. ARM 3, N = 3, bar 2
of 3, is the only fully out-of-sample count on this registration, and its N is three: it can
support nothing on its own and is filed as report-only for that reason.

(b) THE CARD DOES NOT CLEAR THIS BAR ON THE ASSETS IT WAS BUILT ON.
The unfiled control of this build — card v6, V6_ROLES, CLASSIC5, the full corridor
2019-09-08T16:00:00Z → 2026-09-21T16:00:00Z (span 2570 days), 200 campaigns, filed at
research_outputs/tierc10/panel/control_headline.parquet and control_loao.parquet, and reproducing
tierc6's book to control_worst_abs_diff_vs_tierc6 0.0 — reads on its group=ALL rows:
raw panel net +41.7433 R, expectancy +0.2087 R, 90% CI [-0.012774, +0.463319], p_one_sided
0.054486; equal-asset-risk net +44.0870 R, expectancy +0.2204 R, CI [-0.012268, +0.478070], p
0.066233. Both intervals STRADDLE ZERO, so on its home panel the card is NOT SUPPORTED under the
very verdict law this registration will be judged by, and neither p clears 0.016667. Under the
lineage sensitivity seed 20260816 it still does not clear: raw sens CI [-0.012774, +0.487877],
sens p 0.057486. Its LOAO line is 2/5 above against a bar of 3/5, and the two panels that clear are
the two that drop a LOSING asset (drop BTCUSDT → +0.2900, CI [0.061748, 0.565102]; drop NEARUSDT →
+0.2707, CI [0.023661, 0.565102]), while dropping ZECUSDT leaves +0.0628 with CI
[-0.060665, +0.186815].
Per asset, on the raw book: ZECUSDT +0.8517 R (net +31.5137 R of the raw panel total +41.7433 R —
75.494% of it), SOLUSDT +0.2705 (+9.7387), ETHUSDT +0.1459 (+7.0014), NEARUSDT -0.0392 (-1.5676),
BTCUSDT -0.1267 (-4.9429). The ALL/raw_panel row's top_decile_share_pct is 72.5795.
A 45% prior on a card whose in-sample row does not clear the bar is a bet that twelve assets no
scored book of this estate has ridden will do what the five it was fitted on did not, on a book
one asset more than three-quarters carries. That is the headwind, stated before the look. It does
not make the test uninteresting — a card that generalises no worse than it fits is itself a
finding — but no reader should be told afterwards that this was expected to clear.

(c) THE BOOK IS PUBLICATION-HETEROGENEOUS, THE SCORED PANEL AND ITS CONTROL DO NOT CARRY THE SAME
PUBLICATION, AND F-D-1 IS RED BY DESIGN.
STAGE_D_MANIFEST venue_publications_disagree: the venue publishes every native bar twice, REST and
BULK ARCHIVE, and the two differ on a small set of incident stamps. At 4h — the lens this card
rides — the measured split of the SCORED TWELVE is: SEVEN carry the ARCHIVE's bar (ENAUSDT XMRUSDT
BNBUSDT UNIUSDT 1000PEPEUSDT DOGEUSDT 1000BONKUSDT), TWO carry REST's (SUIUSDT LTCUSDT), TWO are
identical to both (PUMPUSDT HYPEUSDT), and MNTUSDT_BYBIT is Bybit REST. Nothing is MIXED and
nothing is UNAUDITED. The scored panel is therefore MAJORITY-ARCHIVE, while card v6's home panel is
WHOLLY REST: all five of BTCUSDT ETHUSDT SOLUSDT NEARUSDT ZECUSDT sit in the 4h REST list. The
generalisation test and the control it will be compared against do not rest on the same
publication, and that is a difference between the panels over and above the assets.
The measured size is small — at 4h, 163,447 bars compared against REST with 5 price mismatches and
25 volume-only mismatches — but it is not zero and it is not uniform across the panel.
WHICH HALF OF THE FINDING THIS TEXT LEFT OUT, AND WHY. The same finding also records that the
ARCHIVE is itself an incomplete publication (at 4h it LACKS 120 bars the snapshot holds and
publishes nothing for 947 more, of 172,433 compared, with 6 price and 27 volume-only mismatches);
that "the ARCHIVE" is TWO forms whose monthly and daily zips disagree with each other on 22 bars
across the probed lenses, all BTCUSDT — 1 of 312 compared at 4h, 21 of 26,496 at 5m; and that
assets_split_across_their_own_lenses = [1000BONKUSDT 1000PEPEUSDT BNBUSDT DOGEUSDT ENAUSDT UNIUSDT
XMRUSDT] — SEVEN of the twelve, each ARCHIVE at 5m/1h/4h and REST at 12h. None of it changes a bar
this card reads at 4h, which is why it is not in the paragraph above; it is written here because a
pre-commitment that quotes half a finding must say which half it left.
F-D-1 stays RED and prints RED until the operator rules REST or ARCHIVE [R5 names the pair and the
venue, not the publication]; F-D-1b carries the attribution. Stage D is therefore PARTIAL in the
resume ledger for that reason and that reason only: its four resume clauses — contract multipliers,
F-D-4, F-D-5 and the haircut twin — now exist on disk.

(d) THREE OF THE TWELVE ARE YOUNG, AND YOUTH IS NOT NEUTRAL HERE.
PUMPUSDT offers 2,631 closed 4h bars and arms only at 2025-08-31T20:00:00Z; HYPEUSDT 2,876 and
2025-07-22T00:00:00Z; ENAUSDT 5,413 and 2024-05-25T04:00:00Z. A young asset can return few
campaigns or none. Few campaigns widen the interval; none makes that asset's leave-out panel a
copy of the headline, which is exactly the case the LOAO line of record treats permissively. The
per-asset campaign counts, and any asset with zero campaigns, are printed on the row whatever the
verdict.

8 · THE COST COLUMNS

Every row carries the TC-series toll as the accounting figure of record — round_trip_bps_used 10.0
bps on every one of the seventeen (research_outputs/tierc10/data/fee_schedule.json, fee_law quoted
whole: "fee = (FEE_BPS_SIDE / 10_000) * (entry_px + exit_px) (scripts/tierc2_baseline.py)"),
unchanged. THE COMMITMENT BESIDE IT, STATED AS A COMMITMENT AND NOT AS AN EXISTING COLUMN: the
charter's model rides as a HAIRCUT TWIN — per-side slippage tier A {BTC ETH} 2 bps, tier B {SOL
NEAR ZEC LTC BNB DOGE UNI SUI XMR} 5 bps, tier C {ENA PUMPFUN HYPE MNT PEPE BONK} 10 bps, giving
haircut_twin_round_trip_bps 14.0 for tier A, 20.0 for tier B and 30.0 for tier C. On this panel
that is 20.0 bps round trip for SUI LTC XMR BNB UNI DOGE and 30.0 for ENA PUMPFUN HYPE MNT PEPE
BONK. THE TWIN IS AN ADDED COLUMN AND MAY NEVER BECOME THE TOLL OF RECORD: the verdict, the CI, the
p and the LOAO line are all to be taken on the TC-series toll, exactly as the nine tiers before this
one took them. The twin's net_r is to be reported beside them so a reader can see what the
charter's costs would have done, and a disagreement in sign between the two is to be flagged on the
row.
WHERE THE TWIN LIVES TODAY, SO THE PROMISE IS FALSIFIABLE: fee_schedule.json haircut_twin_law,
whose first sentence reads whole "ADDED, never a replacement: haircut_twin_* keys carry the
charter model (per-side taker fee + the charter's per-side slippage tier) beside
round_trip_bps_used, which stays the TC-series accounting figure on every row [VETO 'tiers']" and
whose second gives the twin's formula and names tierc10_data.haircut_twin_net_r.
scripts/tierc10_data.py carries haircut_twin_net_r, haircut_twin_for_stem and haircut_twin_table.
scripts/tierc10_panel.py contains ZERO occurrences of "haircut_twin" as this text is filed. So the
twin columns will appear on P-GEN-1's row only if score() is wired to that module first. If the
row is produced without them, the row is INCOMPLETE against this registration and must say so; it
does not change the verdict, which was never the twin's to give.

4 · THE SIGNAL — MECHANICS, READ FROM THE CODE, NOT INVENTED

PINS OF RECORD, read from research_outputs/tierc10/STEP0_RECORD.json · pins_of_record (pins_reconciled: "PINS-OK 12/12 — port == machine == Pine, key order included"). That dict holds TWELVE keys, not nine; the nine this text's mechanics turn on are LEG_MIN 0.5 · REV_MIN 1.75 · TOUCH_EPS 0.6 · DEV_RETURN_BARS 7 · BREAK_CONFIRM_N 8 · BREAK_MARGIN 1.5 · BOUNDARY_MODE "body" · SCALE_MULT 3.0 · ATR_LEN 14, and the remaining three, named here so the nine are not mistaken for the whole dict, are FLIP_HOLD_MARGIN 1.0 · FLIP_HOLD_BARS 6 · MEM_TTL_BARS 400.

THE MACRO SCALE. SCALE_MULT 3.0 multiplies LEG_MIN and REV_MIN only (`analytics/rangefinder_census.macro_pins`, :215-220): the macro layer runs at LEG_MIN 1.5, REV_MIN 5.25, every other pin unchanged. This is the census's `frozen3.0` scale kind, not the per-asset `calibrated` one; the calibrated kind is not this lane's, and §10(h) prints what that pre-commitment costs.

A CONFIRMED MACRO BOUNDARY. A range is SEEDED from two terminal pivots of opposite sign at the macro pins, its top and bottom taken from the pivot bars' BODIES (BOUNDARY_MODE "body"); a degenerate cluster with top <= bottom is refused. It is POTENTIAL until price touches the boundary OPPOSITE the seed's final pivot within TOUCH_EPS = 0.6 ATR — then and only then it is CONFIRMED, at that bar (`confirm_i`, `born_at`). A close beyond either boundary while still POTENTIAL INVALIDATES it instead. Only a CONFIRMED range has a breach lifecycle, and only a CONFIRMED range's boundary can be swept by this lane's signal.

BREACH-OPEN. On a CONFIRMED range, the first bar whose CLOSE sits beyond a boundary opens a deviation on that side; the extreme is tracked from that bar forward.

DIE. While the deviation is open, the range DIES on BREAK_CONFIRM_N = 8 closes beyond, or on a close BREAK_MARGIN = 1.5 ATR beyond. A DIE is not this lane's signal.

HARDEN — THE DEVIATION-CONFIRM. The first bar that CLOSES BACK INSIDE, at bars_outside = i - open_i <= DEV_RETURN_BARS = 7, is a HARDEN: the deviation is counted and the boundary is REDRAWN to the deviation's wick extreme. (At these pins breach-lapse is unreachable — analytics/rangefinder_census.py:142-143 says so in the source, its two comment lines joined and their `# ` markers dropped: "at these pins breach-lapse is UNREACHABLE (BREAK_CONFIRM_N <= DEV_RETURN_BARS + 1); the law stays implemented, as in the machine" — 8 <= 7 + 1.) The harden bar is the signal.

DIRECTION, BOTH WAYS [R3/R9]. Bottom-side harden -> LONG spring. Top-side harden -> SHORT upthrust. The top side is the bottom side's exact mirror on the negated tape, and F-RF-4 is parametrised over both and prints both. The floor arms on the campaign's own favourable excursion — the first bar whose favourable extreme

So the latch bar is walked on its 48 native 5m children in tape order (N_5M_PER_4H = MS_4H // MS_5M
= 48, an identity, not a pin). The rule of record, quoted verbatim from lanes/build_manifest.json,

  stands, dip-after -> BE fill at entry inside the bar, same child -> adverse-first and counted,
  4h/5m extreme mismatch -> counted and adverse-first, and a print with NO dip at all -> the old
  stop stands too"

everything else — `dip_first`, `tie`, `mismatch`, and a print with no dip at all; a third answer

grid inside the parent, and reproduce the parent's high AND low; on a mismatch the bar is COUNTED
and falls back to adverse-first, and is never silently resolved in either direction. The module

§7 · WHAT WOULD COUNT AS SUPPORT — AND WHAT WOULD NOT

has NOT met this registration. The composite above is deliberately stricter than the scorer's
column, and the collision of words is named here so nobody later reads the column as the claim.

CLAUSE (c) RESOLVES ON THIS ROW ALONE and does not wait for siblings. `finish_family` sets

## 4 · CLASSIC5 ONLY — AND WHAT THAT ACTUALLY PROTECTS

WHAT THE PANEL IS NOT: it is not virgin, and this text will not say it is. Read against F-D-5

own definitions are on that file: never-touched = "the asset has never appeared in any scored result

have been looked at but never scored. P-GEN-1's DRAFTED text carries that same qualification AS OF
THIS FILING — research_outputs/tierc10/REGISTRATION_TEXTS.md reads "It does not claim the twelve are
virgin. Three are; nine were looked at." — but that draft is not itself filed and can still change,

This is the single grid cell the contract permits to be named in advance. Naming it in advance fixes
the candidate here, in text, before the TIER-C10 corridor is ridden, so the result cannot be
back-fitted into a hypothesis. What pre-naming does NOT do is make the cell out of sample — see §7.

## 5 · THE RULER, THE LINE, AND WHAT WOULD COUNT AS SUPPORT

SCORED ARM (the one slot this registration owns in m): ruler `two_sample`, base `card-v6`. The base
is a Book from `run_cell_n` carrying `CONTROL_RIDE` on the same panel over the same window — the
known control, which rides unregistered by design. The statistic is the RAW panel expectancy of the
arm minus the raw panel expectancy of the base, with an asset-cluster bootstrap difference interval
(`cluster_boot_diff`), 90% percentile, seed 20260921, 4000 draws. `tierc10_panel.LEAN_PANEL_VERDICT`
reads, verbatim: "the SCORED statistic (verdict, p vs the BH bar) is the RAW panel expectancy — the
lineage's ruler since TIER-C5; the equal-asset-risk co-headline carries its own NEW cluster-bootstrap
CI and a would-be verdict beside it and gates nothing; disagreement is flagged on the row."

arm must not share its WHOLE campaign key set (symbol, lane, entry_ms) with the base, or `score()`
HALTs and no number exists. The estate's reason for EXPECTING it to hold is on file and is a fact
about this cell, not a law about trigger swaps: TIER-C9's grid row for `trigger-9/12` recorded 19
shared campaigns against 177 arm-only and 177 base-only — for that cell on that corridor the swap
replaced the book rather than refining it. The sibling cell refutes any general version of the
claim: `trigger-9/26` on the same grid shared 75 of 193. On the TIER-C9 precedent the D15 paired
trio is EXPECTED to be thin here — and, as §7(a) sets out, thin to the point where one member of it
cannot be computed at all; the row prints whatever it actually is. Both intervals print regardless.

SUPPORT, and nothing else counts as support:
  · VERDICT: SUPPORTED iff the 90% CI's LOWER bound is STRICTLY > 0. Not the point estimate, not the
    upper bound, not p. A bound of exactly 0.0, a missing bound, a straddling interval and an
    interval wholly below zero are all NOT SUPPORTED. The verdict is CI-ONLY and nothing else in
    this section can change it.

REPORTED BESIDE THE VERDICT, AND DECIDING NOTHING:
  · ROBUSTNESS (REPORTED, NOT DECIDING — the verdict is CI-only, per §8): the leave-one-asset-out
    line, scored by the SAME ruler as the headline.
    LOAO LINE OF RECORD: lineage count — N is the DECLARED panel, so a declared asset that yields no

Only a leave-out panel whose DROPPED asset yielded at least one holdout campaign can count toward the line; the denominator stays 5 either way. So with N = 5 and a bar of 3, the numerator can be at most 5 minus the number of SILENT assets. If THREE or more of the five declared assets yield no holdout campaign, the line CANNOT be cleared at all, however the remaining panels print: at three silent the numerator's ceiling is 2, below the bar of 3 — and those two panels could not be bootstrapped in any case, since dropping one of the two non-silent assets leaves a single cluster and loao_n's "len(av) < 2 or len(set(ac)) < 2" guard records such a panel as "too few clusters". That is accepted as the cost of the stricter line and is not a reason to revisit it afterwards.

The above-half bar is above_half_bar(N) = ceil((N+1)/2) — 3 of 5, 7 of 12, 9 of 17. Operator ruling R8 sets this panel's bar at 3 of 5, which is the N = 5 case of that one law and not a separate rule; nothing has been overridden.
